psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan on about 200 hours over a single playthrough (PowerPyx rates the set 4/10), with the 100% checklist as the long tail. No online trophies and no DLC are needed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
tips: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup.
Keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Story trophy — it pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss; just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins (PowerPyx). Unmissable — keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2, popping as Chapter 3 opens. Unmissable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life (PowerPyx). Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4, popping after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero (PowerPyx). Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission — the same mission that ends Chapter 4, Starting From Zero, per PowerPyx. Finish the story and it pops; unmissable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops during the mission itself; just play through Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — it pops as the mission completes.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — the last of the mission trophies.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx and GTA Zone: finish the 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on it is missable, and most of it falls out of the other trophies, so leave it for after the credits and work it in free roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road
tips: Scan vehicles and study animals from the start — they count early.
The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 300. Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them — under-the-bridge runs are the quickest (PowerPyx). Track progress per region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
tips: A stunt counts the first time you perform it; the extra challenges on each map icon are not required.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race and performing a stunt (PowerPyx). Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 ranges (PowerPyx). The medals are not as hard as they sound, and range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. Work through the ranges after the story if any golds are missing.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total, and all 42 are needed for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx). One win per location is enough for the trophy; repeat a location's easiest race if a win does not come first try.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations (PowerPyx). Winning the same race twice does not count — spread your wins across the map. Drone race wins also count toward the race types, so this overlaps with Top Fun.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline (PowerPyx). Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels at least once. Four games exist (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, Bang For Your Buck); the first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, the fourth at arcade machines around the world (PowerPyx). Pick whichever you like best; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline — 5 quests, Lucia-only, starting in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville (PowerPyx): Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline: 7 shipwreck treasure dives, marked with purple chest icons after he calls you in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx). Dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to Kenton in Key Lento. He goes quiet during parts of the story but comes back in Chapters 2–3 — nothing is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline — 5 jobs from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (PowerPyx): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only certain questlines count (PowerPyx). Confirmed counters: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strands are still there after the story; check the count on the trophy itself in the PSN list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he asks for, starting with the Zorrusso stolen during the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (PowerPyx). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City — a clean delivery pays more. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Doable entirely after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline — Jason-only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty (PowerPyx). Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, shuts the labs down and pops the trophy. Available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 (PowerPyx). The possibly missable trophy — the only one PowerPyx and GTA Zone flag. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. That house meditation is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The last spots need Jason and Lucia playable together (after Chapter 2: Coffee Break). Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Note: 100% only needs 15 of 18, so this cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.missableNote: Do the Chapter 1 house meditation before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only meditation that can disappear. Everything else can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
tips: Do the balcony meditation the first morning it is offered — do not put it off.
You can only finish the last spots once both characters are playable together.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline starts after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason-only, PowerPyx). Bret hands you the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest and marks hunting spots in purple; bring the animals back to him. The exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, and all 15 of his target decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway, so work the whole line.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 sets in the game (PowerPyx). Cards are a collectible type — pick up sets as you explore; the 100% checklist does not require all of them, so any 3 sets will do.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — scan objects in the world by holding Up then R1 with the WAiNK app. Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags (PowerPyx). There are well over 100, so just scan as you explore; vehicle scans for Whip It Good use the same app.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way (PowerPyx). Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies — save the picky ones for last and choose the easiest 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. You can only do this after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Cause chaos until 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a known escape route (PowerPyx). It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault jobs always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Start after Chapter 2: Coffee Break (call your partner with Right + Triangle), keep the flashing wanted level alive across all 3 shops, and loot each one properly — PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (unlocked after Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) and breaking the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not fire, hit a 4th.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle, hold R1 to scan). You do not need to drive them. A busy road gives you dozens in minutes (PowerPyx). The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops early on that road. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Focus slows time and drains the purple bar, so buff it first: eat and drink, wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to extend it; wear body armor and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 (PowerPyx). Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and fire without missing. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus level 4 it gets much easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
tips: Raise Focus to level 4 first — the window lasts far longer.
Gang operations give you the densest groups of valid enemies.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and make an unscheduled departure. The plane must be one connected to a boarding bridge — the E3/E4 terminal plane is the easiest (PowerPyx): drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) and take out enemies from inside it. Tanks sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance (PowerPyx). Enter a tank, shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry robberies get marked with green icons (PowerPyx). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — out of 8 total, and the 100% checklist wants all 8 (PowerPyx). Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open; bring your partner to carry a second bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. Every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to go unrecognised. Up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
tips: Vault jobs also feed Hot Together, A Classic Blitz Play and Dime on the Dollar — do them together.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults — robbing a vault counts as robbing an armored truck (PowerPyx). Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, grab the cash and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is a plane: fly over every black-fogged area until none is left (PowerPyx). You can grab a plane early in Chapter 1. PSN tracks 52 areas.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39 operations (PowerPyx). Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. No published guide has pinned down the trigger as of 19 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx lists it as unknown). The description — enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — suggests ordering a drink at a beachfront bar in Ocean Beach and waiting for the scene to play out. Try the obvious beach bars first; this entry will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. No published guide has pinned down the trigger as of 19 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx lists it as unknown). The description — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — points to driving a car out through a dealership's front window, GTA-style. Try a showroom in Vice City; this entry will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn and steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item (PowerPyx). It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the valuables can be collected across multiple visits — not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs (filter Map > Activities) — always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them), because while one trains, the other completes training automatically (PowerPyx). You can only do this after Chapter 2: Coffee Break, when switching between both characters opens up.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — PSN tracks the count (0/500). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever something counts (PowerPyx). Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you toward Professional; killing pushes Violent, Psycho and eventually the permanent Irredeemable — avoid that one, since cops shoot on sight. It accrues passively across robberies and fights, so leave it for last and farm it only if needed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. No published guide has pinned down the trigger as of 19 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue). 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — the Payday Loans angle is the lead to watch. This entry will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. No published guide has pinned down the trigger as of 19 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline). 'What the hell just happened?' fits a strange encounter — keep an eye on the skies and on odd side content after the story. This entry will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. No published guide has pinned down the trigger as of 19 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle). 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' reads as knocking enemies down with a melee attack from a moving bike. Try melee attacks from a motorcycle against pedestrians or enemies. This entry will be updated when players crack it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts — a running total, not one delivery (PowerPyx). Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer first by finishing Chapter 3: Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 per job, so this comes naturally with Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn it, since they are the most expensive (PowerPyx). It accrues across every shop type: 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops, 11 tattoo studios and more. You will be most of the way there by the time you finish the other money trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (4 story garages do not count) — $160,000 in total (PowerPyx). Garages go on sale after Chapter 2: Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. Buy them through the phone app. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the fastest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives on your phone after Chapter 2: Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then Respray and Register in his garage (PowerPyx). Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Moses only takes cars without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can register Standard Tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
